notes.title: Deluxe Version: New Year, New Update!
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

All the dust has settled down and looks like you all like the game. Don't be shy then, feel free to post a comment and a review on the store page, it will help us a lot! On the other hand, if you found any bugs or issues, make sure to post it on the forums.

With this update come several fixes and changes in DELUXE VERSION:

FEATURE: we added special spawner in front of player starting location that will spawn powerup, barrel or exploding barrel on beginning of every wave.
CRITICAL FIX: different boss types will now appear properly, as most of the time it was the same guy over and over.
MINOR FIXES:
- double damage works now properly with railgun,
- Piercing Shots perk will actually pierce targets now,
- level music will now properly reset after the boss fight,
- drones will not crash into one another so often,
- rebalanced point systems.

Happy new year!

notes.title: First steps: First update and DELUXE version announcement
notes.content:
Hello,

We are really pleased with your warm responses and all the insights into how we can make the game even better. It feels great to release first game in atmosphere of such enthusiasm. We feel honored!

Thanks to all of your amazing feedback, we prepared an important update on game flow and rebalanced few values to enhance the experience. Those are all listed below, but before that we have important information about the Regenesis Arcade DELUXE version, which is much more expanded and packed with content.

We decided to push the Regenesis Arcade DELUXE release date to 18th of December.

It wasn't easy for us, as we feel very excited about releasing our most polished product and we are eager to hear your feedback on how can we improve it. However, different factors, including our perfectionism, made us wait just a few days more, so that all the right features are perfectly balanced. Let us assure you those few days more will be worth it!

Most important changes in this Lite update:
- replaced tutorial wave shooting section with cut right to the Arcade Mode, so that proper gameplay can be experienced much faster than before,
- increased gravity gun range for better game feel and usability,
- rebalanced waves and enemy values to enhance the experience,
- fixed different issues regarding physics.

Once again, thank you for your input and keep your eyes open for DELUXE version!

Hyperbook Studio
